method: Stage10 production UI review through actual clicks and keyboard; unchanged legacy campaign loaded, no grants or save edits.

entries.text: Legacy damaged seven-frigate force: proportional hull, movement and original-route disclosure.
Keyboard-selected two-ship detachment on a laptop viewport.
The new two-ship formation is selected, with repair, merge, split and heritage actions.
The detachment retains the original expedition history.
All four fleet actions remain usable on laptop.
One eight-hull pool is shared proportionally between the damaged formations.
Original fleet retains its plotted course alongside all fleet actions.
Mobile controls and horizontal route strip with the original fleet selected.

Repeated eight ordinary merge/split pairs, spending the remaining 16 orders to exercise the zero-order preview state. No hull, resources or movement were granted or edited; original route remained with Vanguard 3.
With zero orders, native keyboard selection remains usable and preview updates to three detached ships; confirmation explains the unavailable order.
Zero-order preview at390px remains fully readable; ship selection is available while confirmation is disabled.

After ordinary end cycle, original hull displays 168/170 and detached hull displays 68/68 because the existing UI rounds upward. Actual detached hull is 67.02857142857144/68. Remaining total recovery is 3.4, showing the previous 8-hull shared forecast was applied once.

Zero-order native selector remained enabled and keyboard-changeable; confirmation disabled with explicit no-orders explanation. Actual cycle59→60 completed normally with both formations atVeyrPrime and original course retained. Shared repair forecast for next turn falls from8 to3.4 total.
